Name: Target day
Description: Every tank should reach its target stock by the end of this day and be held there.

Name: Barrels per truck
Description: One truck carries this many barrels (1000 barrels = 1 MB).

Name: Capacity
Description: Tank capacity (average of the plan query).

Name: Max fill
Description: Maximum filling level the power plant allows; it is also the target the optimal plan fills to (Stock_Limits).

Name: Min fill
Description: Minimum stock level (SFI); below it a tank is at risk.

Name: Max trucks per day
Description: Most trucks the unloading skids can take in a day (Unloading_Skids). 99999 = no skid data, no limit applied.

Name: Ready
Description: 1 when capacity, max fill and stock are known; tanks that are not ready get no optimal plan.

Name: Opening stock
Description: Actual stock on the as-of date.
